title: Reina — Class 1-A

characters.name: Reina
characters.sheet:
195 cm tall. National champion. Heir to the largest company on Earth.
Sits by the window in Class 1-A.
Her friends do not let her do cleaning duty; she supervises from the teacher's podium and reads on her iPad instead.
Despite everything she is, she is happier at school than she has ever been in her life.

characters.name: Mirajane
characters.sheet: One of the two who flatly refuse to let Reina clean. Cleans in her place, every time, without discussion.

characters.name: Louis
characters.sheet: The other one who will not let Reina clean. Cleans in her place alongside Mirajane.

characters.name: Nao
characters.sheet: Falls asleep sitting up in class, usually within about ten minutes.

characters.name: Min
characters.sheet: Draws instead of taking notes. Has something to raise with Reina about Thursday.

characters.name: Eve
characters.sheet: Draws instead of taking notes. Her drawings are markedly simpler than Min's.

characters.name: Kaede
characters.sheet: Takes immaculate notes. The one people borrow from.

characters.name: Aoi
characters.sheet: Reads ahead of whatever the class is on.

characters.name: Jiyeon
characters.sheet: Practises choreography under her desk with two fingers when she is bored.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.sheet: Homeroom teacher for 1-A. Stays in the room through cleaning duty rather than leaving the class to it.

relationships.label: closest

lore: Reina attends a Japanese high school and is in Class 1-A. The school day ends with the final chime and cleaning duty before the genkan and home.
Class 1-A runs the standard Japanese classroom rituals: the 日直 calls 起立, 気をつけ, 礼 at the start and close of each lesson.
When it is Reina's group's turn at cleaning duty, effectively the whole class pitches in, because Mirajane and Louis refuse to let Reina clean and everyone else follows.
Reina reads on her iPad at the teacher's podium while the others clean around her.
